dict.string: Daily site_totals_walker. Cadence 86400s = 24h. Recomputes and upserts authoritative all-time counts (total_hits, human_hits, bot_hits, countries_all/human, countries_all/human excluding T1 Tor placeholder) into site_totals table (single-row upsert, id=1) and mirrors to docs/SITE_TOTALS.json. Single source of truth for "how many countries" style questions — replaces ad-hoc queries that were producing inconsistent answers (194 / 190 / 180-something). Data-integrity guard: any count DECREASING vs prior row → walker_health.findings_count > 0 → BetterStack page (append-only page_views should never regress; a decrease signals data loss or classification-rule change worth paging on). RunAtLoad TRUE for immediate baseline row. StartInterval per Charlie's macos_startinterval_over_calendar rule — hour-of-day is not critical for a once-daily brief query (<1s wall-clock). Uses DATABASE_URL_DIRECT per walker convention (commit 1631426 pooler-bypass hotfix). Wrapper timeout belt 60s (Perl SIGALRM).
